snapshot_assertion_sql:
WITH pin AS (SELECT '2b8ffccd-a87a-4450-8c8a-5cfed318e1e4'::uuid id,'644a003880a69146f8e0ba4a41eba2720d30101f54230ef59c3c4699ebc0d1ff'::text sha),
pub AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT p.* FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_publication p JOIN pin ON p.publication_id=pin.id),
members AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT m.*,v.result,v.received_units,
(v.validation_id IS NOT NULL AND v.family_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.family_id AND v.partition_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.partition_key AND v.expected_manifest_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.expected_manifest_sha256 AND v.observed_manifest_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.observed_manifest_sha256) validation_link_matches
FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_publication_member m JOIN pin ON m.publication_id=pin.id LEFT JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_validation v USING(validation_id)),
checks AS (SELECT m.*,s.n snapshot_rows,s.hash_errors,s.link_errors,s.duplicate_units
FROM members m CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT count(*) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE o.snapshot_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(o.observation::text,'UTF8')),'hex')) hash_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE o.validation_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.validation_id OR o.validation_state IS DISTINCT FROM m.result) link_errors,
count(*)-count(DISTINCT o.unit_key) duplicate_units
FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_published_observation o WHERE o.publication_id=m.snapshot_publication_id AND o.family_id=m.family_id AND o.partition_key=m.partition_key) s)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pub)=1 pinned_publication_exists,
(SELECT p.manifest_sha256=pin.sha AND p.manifest_sha256=encode(sha256(convert_to(p.manifest::text,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM pub p CROSS JOIN pin) manifest_hash_matches,
(SELECT classification FROM pub) classification,
(SELECT manifest->>'publication_purpose' FROM pub) purpose,
(SELECT count(*) FROM members) member_count,
coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('family_id',family_id,'partition_key',partition_key,'validation_id',validation_id,'snapshot_publication_id',snapshot_publication_id,'expected_manifest_sha256',expected_manifest_sha256,'observed_manifest_sha256',observed_manifest_sha256,'validation_result',result,'validation_link_matches',validation_link_matches,'received_units',received_units,'snapshot_rows',snapshot_rows,'snapshot_count_matches',snapshot_rows IS NOT DISTINCT FROM received_units,'hash_errors',hash_errors,'link_errors',link_errors,'duplicate_units',duplicate_units) ORDER BY family_id,partition_key) FROM checks),'[]'::jsonb) assertions,
(SELECT array_agg(f ORDER BY f) FROM unnest(ARRAY['CTX02','CTX06','CTX07','CTX14','D01','D02','D03','D04','D05','F01','F02','F03','F04','F05','F06','N01','N02','N03','P01','P02','REF01','REF03','S01','S02']) f WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM members m WHERE m.family_id=f)) absent_snapshot_families,
false family_acceptance_granted;
adversarial_readonly_test_sql:
WITH base AS MATERIALIZED(
SELECT o.*,v.received_units,v.result,m.expected_manifest_sha256,v.expected_manifest_sha256 v_expected
FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_publication_member m JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_published_observation o ON o.publication_id=m.snapshot_publication_id AND o.family_id=m.family_id AND o.partition_key=m.partition_key JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_validation v ON v.validation_id=m.validation_id WHERE m.publication_id='2b8ffccd-a87a-4450-8c8a-5cfed318e1e4' LIMIT 1),
tests AS(
SELECT 'original_snapshot_hash' test,snapshot_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(observation::text,'UTF8')),'hex') ok FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'changed_observation_rejected',snapshot_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to((observation||'{"ref03_adversarial_mutation":true}'::jsonb)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_hash_rejected',NULL::text IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(observation::text,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'changed_hash_rejected',repeat('0',64) IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(observation::text,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'original_validation_link',expected_manifest_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_expected FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'changed_validation_manifest_rejected',repeat('0',64) IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_validation_manifest_rejected',NULL::text IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_snapshot_count_rejected',0::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM received_units FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'extra_snapshot_count_rejected',(received_units+1) IS DISTINCT FROM received_units FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_received_count_rejected',received_units IS DISTINCT FROM NULL::bigint FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'validation_state_changed_rejected','PASS' IS DISTINCT FROM result FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_validation_state_rejected',NULL::text IS DISTINCT FROM result FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'wrong_publication_pin_absent',NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_publication WHERE publication_id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_unit_detected',count(*)-count(DISTINCT unit_key)=1 FROM (SELECT unit_key FROM base UNION ALL SELECT unit_key FROM base) d
) SELECT count(*) checks,count(*) FILTER(WHERE ok IS TRUE) passed,jsonb_agg(test) FILTER(WHERE ok IS NOT TRUE) failures FROM tests;
estate_assertion_sql:
WITH pubs AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_publication WHERE published_at<='2026-10-27T05:17:00Z'),
a AS(SELECT p.publication_id,p.manifest,p.manifest_sha256,s.manifest_sha256 admission_sha,s.manifest->>'body_sha256' body_sha FROM pubs p LEFT JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_admission_v1 s ON s.document_key=p.manifest->>'document_key' WHERE p.manifest->>'publication_purpose'='DECODED_FINANCIAL_SOURCE_ARCHIVE_ONLY'),
b AS(SELECT a.*,x.n,x.rows_total,x.gaps,x.invalid_counts FROM a CROSS JOIN LATERAL(
SELECT count(*) n,sum((value->>'source_rows')::bigint) rows_total,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE (value->>'first_ordinal')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(previous_last,0)+1) gaps,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE (value->>'source_rows')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM (value->>'last_ordinal')::bigint-(value->>'first_ordinal')::bigint+1 OR (value->>'selected_rows')::bigint<0 OR (value->>'selected_rows')::bigint>(value->>'source_rows')::bigint) invalid_counts
FROM(SELECT value,lag((value->>'last_ordinal')::bigint) OVER(ORDER BY ord) previous_last FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.manifest->'batches') WITH ORDINALITY t(value,ord)) y) x)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pubs) publications,(SELECT count(*) FROM pubs WHERE manifest_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(manifest::text,'UTF8')),'hex')) publication_hash_errors,
count(*) financial_archives,count(DISTINCT manifest->>'document_key') archived_documents,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE admission_sha IS DISTINCT FROM manifest->>'admission_sha256' OR body_sha IS DISTINCT FROM manifest->>'body_sha256') admission_link_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE rows_total IS DISTINCT FROM (manifest->>'source_fact_nodes')::bigint OR gaps>0 OR invalid_counts>0 OR n=0) batch_shape_errors,
encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(publication_id::text||':'||manifest_sha256,E'\n' ORDER BY publication_id),'UTF8')),'hex') financial_publication_pin_sha256,
false independent_numerical_acceptance FROM b;
